title: Revenue Fell by a Seventh, Profit by Nine Tenths
subtitle: Severstal preserved most of its sales in the first half of 2026, but earnings deteriorated much faster as margins and cash generation collapsed.

source.name: Severstal H1 2026 financial results reported by Kommersant

data.label: Revenue
data.annotation: Sales declined, but the operating structure deteriorated much faster.

data.label: Net profit
data.annotation: Net profit fell to 4.2 billion rubles.

supportingFacts.label: Free cash flow in H1 2026, leading the company to withhold its second-quarter dividend.
Revenue remained substantial even as profitability collapsed.

metadata.keyFinding: Severstal profit declined far faster than revenue.
